newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt private interbank market closed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt private interbank market closed.

text.p: The Egyptian pound private interbank market was closed on Wednesday, the first day of the financial year.
State banks worked as usual as their financial year starts on July 1.
On Tuesday, overnight rates were between 10 and 10-3/8 against Monday's 10-1/8 and 10-3/16 percent.
Average one-week rates fell to 10-1/4 percent from 10-1/16 and 10-3/8 percent on Monday.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
